title: Scrum Master
details:
About Delve Health

Delve Health develops modern software platforms that support clinical research and decentralized clinical trials. Our technology helps sponsors, CROs, research sites, and participants collect high-quality clinical data through secure, intuitive digital experiences. All of it is built to meet the regulatory and compliance requirements of the life sciences industry.

As we expand the platform, we are looking for a Scrum Master to help our engineering team deliver predictably and well. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, QA, Customer Success, and leadership to ship software that improves clinical research and patient outcomes.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an organized, hands-on Scrum Master to lead Agile delivery for our engineering team. You will run the Scrum process, keep work moving, and remove the obstacles that slow the team down. You will also help the team grow into a high-performing, self-organizing group.

This is not a process-only role. We want someone who cares about what we build as much as how we build it. You will take part in product discussions, weigh in on UI and UX, and help the team understand the why behind each feature.

The ideal candidate has managed or led engineering teams, ideally in a regulated software environment. Healthcare, life sciences, and medical devices are a plus, but experience in any regulated space is welcome. You understand why quality, traceability, and documentation matter throughout the Software Development Lifecycle. Most importantly, you want to build products that genuinely help people. Our platform supports clinical research that leads to better treatments and patient outcomes, and we are looking for someone who finds real meaning in that.

Key Responsibilities

**Agile delivery and team leadership**

* Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, including Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Lead and support the engineering team day to day, keeping work organized, visible, and on track.
* Identify and remove blockers, escalating to leadership when needed.
* Track sprint progress, velocity, and delivery metrics, and use them to improve predictability.
* Coach engineers and stakeholders on Agile best practices, and continuously improve team processes.
* Mentor team members and help them grow, fostering a collaborative, accountable culture.

**Product and user experience**

* Partner with Product to shape and refine the backlog so priorities reflect business value and customer needs.
* Help turn requirements into clear user stories with detailed acceptance criteria.
* Take part in product decisions, bringing the team's perspective on scope, feasibility, and trade-offs.
* Contribute to UI and UX discussions, and advocate for intuitive experiences for sites and participants.
* Join feature demos, release readiness activities, and customer feedback sessions.

**Quality and compliance**

* Collaborate with QA so acceptance criteria are met before release.
* Maintain traceability between requirements, development work, testing, and releases.
* Keep sprint documentation, release notes, and process records complete and audit-ready.
* Work with Engineering leadership to balance technical debt with feature development and support release planning.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, or similar role.
* Proven experience leading or managing software engineering teams through the full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
* Deep understanding of Agile Scrum and hands-on experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies.
* A genuine drive to build products that help others, with real interest in product decisions, UI/UX, and building great software, not just running process.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar Agile tools.
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* You are motivated by helping others do their best work.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in a regulated industry, such as healthcare, life sciences, medical devices, financial services, insurance, aerospace, or energy.
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as FDA 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, GDPR, GxP, SOX, or ISO standards.
* Experience supporting software validation, traceability, and quality processes.
* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or an equivalent Agile certification.
* Experience working with distributed engineering teams across time zones.
* Exposure to UX design practices, prototyping tools or user research.
* Experience with decentralized clinical trials (DCT), ePRO/eCOA, eConsent, eSource, CTMS, or EDC platforms.

What Success Looks Like

* Sprints run on a steady, predictable cadence, and the team consistently delivers what it commits to.
* Blockers are surfaced early and resolved quickly.
* Engineers feel supported, understand the purpose behind their work, and grow in their roles.
* Product, Engineering, QA, and Customer Success collaborate smoothly, with clear handoffs.
* Releases are high quality, well documented, and traceable from requirement to deployment.
* The team's product and UX input visibly improves what we ship.

What We Offer

* A key role in shaping the future of a growing healthcare technology company.
* A collaborative, engineering-focused culture where your contributions directly influence product success.
* A flexible work environment with an emphasis on ownership, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Opportunities for career growth as the organization expands.

details:

**Role Summary**
----------------

The Senior Automation Engineer is responsible for designing, deploying, and maintaining scalable infrastructure automation across compute and cloud domains. This role leads DevOps-driven practices, IaC tooling (Ansible, Terraform), and provides governance-compliant automation modules to support OS provisioning, patching, monitoring, and recovery processes.

------------------------

· Design and implement reusable automation frameworks (IaC, Ansible).

· Integrate automation into CI/CD toolchains and approval workflows.

· Expert in Ansible, Terraform, scripting languages (PowerShell, Python).

· Knowledge of OS provisioning, backup, and performance automation.

· Strong documentation and governance orientation.

-------------------------------------

· Bachelors in engineering or computer science.

· 7+ years in IT automation roles with leadership in IaC delivery.

· Certifications: HashiCorp Terraform Associate, Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, ITIL v4.

  

**DXC Platform Proficiency (Required)**
---------------------------------------

* DXC ROMS (Reusable Orchestration Modules) — primary automation orchestration platform: agentless architecture, RHEL base OS, PostgreSQL database, Jenkins pipelines, Ansible playbooks versioned in Git

* Execution modes: scheduled, human-triggered, ticket-triggered (PARES), mail-triggered (MaMI), API-based

* HA deployment: RHEL Pacemaker clustering, PostgreSQL synchronous replication

* DXC Arise — Level 1.5 Agentic AI integration for autonomous incident triage and automated ticket enrichment

* DXC OASIS — Single pane of glass management plane for cross-platform analytics

**Observability-Driven Automation (Required)**
----------------------------------------------

* Dynatrace closed-loop automation: Davis AI detection webhook ROMS Ansible playbook execution Dynatrace Metrics API validation

* SolarWinds-triggered network automation: NPM/NTA events ServiceNow workflows Ansible playbooks for:

* WAN degradation diagnostics

* Port flap triage (approval-gated port bounce)

* AP recovery and client rebalancing

* Configuration drift detection and baseline restore (NCM)

* BGP neighbor failure diagnostics

* Pre-meeting wireless readiness validation

* Bridge AIOps — event correlation feeding automation triggers

**Automation Factory Operating Model**
--------------------------------------

* This role operates within the DXC Automation Factory — a 10-person squad using Agile/Scrum delivery (sprint planning, backlog prioritization, controlled releases).

* Squad composition: Automation Factory Lead, Platform Architect (ServiceNow/Dynatrace), Platform Engineers (3), Automation Engineers (2), DEX Automation Engineers (2), Scrum Master (1).

* Automation is opt-in per use case — no production behavior change without Maaden’s explicit authorization.

**ServiceNow Integration (Detailed)**
-------------------------------------

* All automation workflows must integrate with Maaden’s ServiceNow instance:

* Incident auto-creation with diagnostic data

* Change requests with pre-checks, back-out plans, post-validation

* Approval gates via ServiceNow task toggles and standard change templates

* Full evidence trail: what, where, when, outcome, attachments

* CMDB accuracy 97% as a prerequisite for automation targeting

**Governance & Compliance**
---------------------------

* NCA (National Cybersecurity Authority) and NDMO regulatory compliance

* All write actions are approval-gated via ServiceNow

* Pre-checks, back-out plans, and post-validation mandatory for every automated action

* Year 1 target: 40% incident auto-remediation; Year 3 target: 100% eligible categories

**Additional Technical Skills (Required)**
------------------------------------------

* Jenkins — pipeline orchestration and CI/CD for automation releases

* Git — version control with tagging and semantic versioning

* Python — scripting for custom automation and API integration

* PowerShell — Windows automation (WinRM-based execution via ROMS)

**Language**
------------

* Bilingual Arabic and English proficiency required.

details:

**Management Level**

Manager

**Job Description & Summary**

Our Cyber Risk & Strategy team helps organizations understand and manage the risks that come with using technology and digital services.
  
  
We work with clients to answer practical questions such as: Are our most important systems sufficiently protected? Are the right controls in place? Where are the biggest risks, and what needs to improve? Are we meeting regulatory and industry expectations?
  
  
As a (Senior) Manager, you will lead engagements that answer these questions. You will define the approach, guide project teams, challenge client thinking and turn complex cyber, regulatory and control topics into clear decisions and practical improvement plans.

Core Activities: "What you'll be working on"

* **Lead client engagements from start to finish:** Define the workplan, shape the assessment approach and take responsibility for delivery quality and outcomes.
* **Help clients identify what matters most:** Understand their business, technology landscape and risk exposure, then focus attention on the areas with the greatest impact.
* **Turn complex requirements into practical actions:** Translate regulations, standards and control expectations into changes clients can realistically implement.
* **Challenge and advise senior stakeholders:** Discuss findings with management, explain their implications and help clients decide how to respond.
* **Design improvement programs:** Develop target governance models, control frameworks, strategies, remediation plans and transformation roadmaps.
* **Lead and develop teams:** Set direction, review outputs, coach team members and ensure consistent quality across multiple workstreams.
* **Manage client relationships:** Build trust beyond individual projects, understand emerging needs and identify where additional support can create value.
* **Shape the practice:** Contribute to new offerings, methodologies, proposals and capability development.

Key Skills: "What you need to have"

**Typically 7–12+ years of relevant experience** in cyber risk, technology risk, governance, compliance, IT audit, strategy development or related consulting areas.

We are looking for people who can take an unclear or complex client problem and turn it into a structured approach, clear conclusions and realistic actions. You should be comfortable leading teams, challenging senior stakeholders and taking responsibility for the overall quality and direction of an engagement.

Strong communication and judgment are essential. You should be able to explain complex risk topics in business terms, balance regulatory expectations with practical realities and help clients make informed decisions.

Experience across areas such as cyber governance, risk and control assessments, regulatory compliance, third-party risk or technology transformation is valuable. Relevant certifications are an advantage, but leadership, judgment and the ability to solve client problems are more important.

Knowledge Exposure: "What you'll build expertise in"

As a (Senior) Manager, you will move from owning individual workstreams to shaping entire engagements and client relationships. You will deepen your expertise, strengthen your ability to advise senior stakeholders and develop teams, while taking a more active role in creating new solutions, identifying opportunities and growing the practice.

details:

Join us at Orange Business!
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.

With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
The Head of IT Crisis and Problem Management is responsible for leading and overseeing the strategic and operational aspects of crisis/MI and problem management within Orange Business Digital Technology. This role ensures the rapid resolution of major IT incidents, minimizes business disruption, and drives continuous service improvement across a diverse portfolio of 600+ IT business applications. As a leader, you will manage a team of experts, oversee crisis and problem management processes, and collaborate with key stakeholders to minimize disruption, manage risks, and ensure customer satisfaction. Additionally, the role includes acting as Product owner for web and mobile projects, ensuring that these projects support business needs effectively
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  
**Leadership and Management:**  

* Lead and Coach: Manage a team of expert and senior Crisis and Problem Managers responsible for crisis/major incident management, problem management, emergency change management, and service improvement for over 600+ IT business applications at Orange Business Digital Technology.
* Team Development: Set team objectives, manage performance, facilitate training and development, oversee recruitment, and balance workloads to ensure high team efficiency. Ensure culture of resilience and continuous learning within the team, encouraging open communication and collaboration.
* Empowerment: Empower team members to take ownership of their areas of responsibility and encourage them to proactively contribute to crisis and problem resolution.
* OKRs and Reporting: Ensure the achievement of team OKRs with alignment of Digital technology strategic objective and provide detailed operational reporting to top management.
* Continuous Improvement: Lead regular retrospectives and business review events to drive continuous improvement and learning.
* Global Process Ownership: Serve as the Global Process Owner for Digital Technology Major incident and Problem Management processes, ensuring consistency and effectiveness across Digital Technology organization.
* Innovation in Crisis, MI and Problem Management: Identify and implement innovative approaches and technologies to enhance the effectiveness of crisis management and problem resolution.
* Act as Product owner for our RCA portal where all Crisis,MI and problem cases are documented and followed up on.

**Operational Leadership:**  

* Technical Leadership: Act as the technical leader in resolving IT application and service crises and managing reactive and proactive problem management across diverse application types (OSS, BSS, Enterprise) and architectures (DevOps, Cloud, Containers/Kubernetes, API, ESB, load balancers, clusters).
* Process Execution: Execute Digital Technology Crisis Management and Problem Management processes in alignment with ITIL best practices and Agility.
* Root Cause Analysis: Oversee and review Root Cause Analysis (RCA) efforts, ensuring the implementation of definitive solutions, improvement actions, and the generalization of preventive measures across systems as part of proactive problem management.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Orange France, CIO project teams, monitoring teams, QoS, CSMs, SDMs, performance management Design Authority, and service desk teams to ensure smooth operations and crisis resolution.
* Stakeholder Communication: Regularly communicate with key stakeholders, including business leaders, to provide updates on crisis resolution, problem management, and service improvement initiatives.
* Service Improvement: Identify and review Service Improvement Plans (SIPs) and QoS transversal projects to enhance service reliability and performance improvement.
* Reporting and Audits: Lead the creation of weekly IT QoS reviews and conduct regular audits, providing insights and updates to Digital Technology top management.
* Change Management: Collaborate with Digital Technology change management teams to ensure seamless integration of changes during crisis and outside business hours.
* Vendor Coordination: Coordinate with external vendors and third-party service providers during crises to ensure timely resolution and compliance with SLAs.
* Knowledge Management: Supervise and maintain documentation in the knowledge base to ensure accurate and up-to-date information is available to all stakeholders.

**Skills Profile:**  

* University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Excellent English language is mandatory, French language is a plus.
* Proven Management and Leadership skills with a strong track record of leading diverse teams.
* Strong coaching and mentoring abilities to develop team members and enhance performance.
* Mandatory experience in people management, with a proven ability to lead teams through complex challenges.
* 10+ years of experience in IT and enterprise applications, with a significant focus in operations.
* Excellent knowledge of ITIL best practices, with a strong focus on crisis and problem management techniques.
* Solid understanding of Agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and project management principles.
* Extensive experience in application support, architecture, and lifecycle management.
* Strong knowledge in Cloud, Containerization (Kubernetes), Operating Systems, and Databases.
* Strong interpersonal skills with excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, listening, data analysis and decision-making abilities.
* Relevant certifications, including ITIL or Agile certifications, and technical certification in at least one domain (Cloud, DevOps, Database, or Software Development).
* Kepner-Tregoe certification is a plus for structured problem-solving.

You bring a can-do attitude, tackle challenges head-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.
  
  

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.

* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

details:
### **A Snapshot of Your Day**

title: Testing Lead
details:
**Job Family Summary:**

The Quality Assurance (QA) department ensures that every software solution released, from the THYNK and ROBIN modules to core RCM systems, is reliable, functional, and technically sound before it reaches the client.

In a healthcare technology environment like Santechture's, the QA department operates as the final gatekeeper for accuracy and compliance.

**Role Summary:**

The QA Lead is responsible for modernizing Santechture's quality practice and leading the QA team in the delivery of reliable, interoperable healthcare software. The role combines hands-on test automation expertise with the practical adoption of AI in quality engineering, and places strong emphasis on coaching the team in modern QA practices.

The role begins with a structured assessment of the existing QA practice across tooling, process, and organization, followed by the definition and implementation of a remediation roadmap. Once the target practice is in place, the QA Lead organizes the team, leads it on a day-to-day basis as its primary point of reference, and works closely with Software Development, Product Management, and Delivery to ensure predictable, high-quality releases that meet technical standards (HL7/FHIR) and clinical requirements for our healthcare clients in the MENA region.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

**A. QA Practice Assessment & Remediation (Initial Phase)**

* Conduct a structured assessment of the current QA practice, covering tooling, test assets, processes, quality gates, team structure, roles, and skills.
* Establish a quality baseline using measurable indicators such as automation coverage, defect leakage, regression cycle time, and test stability.
* Identify gaps against modern QA practice and define a prioritized remediation roadmap across tooling, process, and organization, for validation by management.
* Lead the implementation of the approved roadmap, tracking progress against milestones and adjusting scope based on measured outcomes.

**B. Test Automation Strategy & Delivery**

* Define and own the test automation strategy based on the test pyramid, balancing unit, API, integration, and UI automation.
* Select, standardize, and maintain automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, REST Assured, Postman/Newman), ensuring maintainable and reusable test code.
* Integrate automated smoke, regression, and build verification suites into CI/CD pipelines, with clear reporting and fast feedback to development teams.
* Drive API and integration test automation for healthcare data exchange (HL7/FHIR), claims workflows, and backend data validation (SQL).
* Manage automation health, including flaky test reduction, test data management, and environment readiness.

**C. AI-Enabled Quality Engineering**

* Introduce and scale the practical use of AI in the QA lifecycle, including test case generation from requirements, test script authoring, test data generation, and defect analysis.
* Evaluate and pilot AI-assisted testing tools, recommending adoption based on measured productivity and quality gains.
* Define guidelines for responsible AI usage in QA, including human review of AI-generated assets and protection of patient and client data.

**D. Coaching & Modern QA Practice**

* Coach QA engineers and testers on modern practices, including shift-left testing, risk-based testing, exploratory testing, and behaviour-driven development (BDD).
* Build team capability through a skills matrix and individual development plans, with a focus on upskilling manual testers into automation and AI-assisted testing.
* Review test designs and automation code, providing structured feedback and enforcing agreed standards.
* Promote quality as a shared responsibility with development teams through joint definition of acceptance criteria and quality gates.

**E. Team Organization & Day-to-Day Leadership**

* Define the QA team structure, roles, and allocation across products and delivery streams, aligned with the remediation roadmap.
* Act as the day-to-day reference for the QA team on priorities, test approach, standards, and issue resolution.
* Plan and manage test capacity, execution schedules, and backlog test queues in terms of deadlines, throughput, and quality of delivery.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for testing and quality with development teams and project delivery leads.

**F. Test Lifecycle & Quality Governance**

* Oversee functional, regression, integration, performance, data integrity, and user acceptance testing (UAT) across Web, API, and Database modules.
* Govern the defect lifecycle in Jira/Azure DevOps, ensuring clear documentation, prioritization, and timely resolution with development leads.
* Provide accurate QA status reporting, release quality metrics, and risk escalations to senior management.

**Job Requirements:**

**Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field.

**Experience:**

* 6+ years of total experience in Software Quality Assurance and Testing, including at least 3 years of hands-on test automation.
* 2+ years of experience leading QA teams, including coaching engineers and driving the adoption of new practices.
* Demonstrated track record of assessing and transforming an existing QA practice across tooling, process, and team organization.
* Strong background in testing enterprise SaaS platforms, complex data workflows, and RESTful APIs.
* Domain Experience: Experience in Healthcare IT, Health Information Systems (HIS), Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), or Insurance Claims processing is strongly preferred.

**Technical Competencies:**

* Advanced hands-on experience with at least one modern automation framework (Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium) and a programming language (TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Python, or C#).
* Hands-on experience with API test automation (REST Assured, Postman/Newman, or similar) and integration testing, with familiarity with HL7/FHIR.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins).
* Practical experience applying AI tools in testing (e.g., GitHub Copilot, LLM-assisted test design, AI-based test platforms), with a clear understanding of their limitations.
* Proficient in SQL querying for backend data validation and database integrity testing.
* Deep experience with test management and defect tracking tools (Jira, Xray, Zephyr, or TestRail).
* Exposure to performance testing tools (JMeter, k6, or similar) is desirable.

**Certifications (Desirable):** ISTQB Advanced Test Automation Engineering, ISTQB Test Manager, ISTQB Certified Tester AI Testing (CT-AI), or Agile Tester Certification.

**Soft Skills:** Strong coaching and mentoring ability, clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, structured problem-solving, attention to detail, and the ability to perform under tight deployment timelines.

**Core Competencies:**

* **Change Leadership:** Drives adoption of new tools and practices, and sustains change through measurable outcomes.
* **Coaching & Capability Building:** Develops team members through hands-on guidance, feedback, and structured learning.
* **Analytical & Systems Thinking:** Diagnoses root causes across tooling, process, and organization rather than symptoms.
* **Ownership & Accountability:** Takes end-to-end responsibility for release quality and follows issues through to resolution.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Aligns QA priorities with Development, Product, and Delivery to support release commitments.

**Ready to Shape the Future?**

**If you are ready to lead the development teams behind the technology that is transforming healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.**

**Join SANTECHTURE and help us deliver scalable, secure, and intelligent healthcare technology solutions across the MENA region.**

**Apply today by submitting your resume.**

title: Senior QA Engineer
details:
Requirements and responsibilities

**Flairstech is looking for a senior QA Engineer to join our engineering team, reporting to the CTO. You'll own quality across a full procurement platform — a Play/Scala and Spring Boot service tier, a React single-page front end, and asynchronous job-processing workers — testing both individual services and the end-to-end workflows customers depend on. A core part of this role is automated testing built into our CI/CD pipeline, so releases are gated on real, reliable test coverage rather than manual passes.**


This role works closely with Product and Engineering on acceptance criteria for defects, participates in release readiness and UAT, and helps scale testing effort to match the risk of what's being shipped.

**What You'll Do**

**Automation & CI/CD**

Build and maintain automated test suites integrated into the CI/CD pipeline so releases are gated on real test coverage.

Own the automated testing strategy across services — expanding coverage over time and reducing reliance on manual regression passes.

Troubleshoot test failures in the pipeline and distinguish real regressions from flaky or environment-specific failures.

**Test Design & Execution**

Design and execute test plans for new features and defect fixes across the Play/Scala and Spring Boot service tier and the React front end.

Write and maintain API-level test coverage for services (core-api, cxml-api, procure APIs) and validate behavior against MySQL and PostgreSQL-backed data.

Own acceptance criteria and verification for defects, and validate acceptance criteria written by Product for enhancements.

Perform regression testing ahead of releases, scaled to each ticket's assessed risk level (technical, operational, and compliance impact).

**Release & Environment Support**

Participate in release-readiness review and sign off on testing scope before releases move to UAT and production.

Validate behavior consistently across environments (dev, staging, UAT, production) and flag environment drift that could affect test reliability.

Support UAT coordination with Business Operations, including reviewing release notes and risk scores ahead of each release.

**What We're Looking For**

**Required**

5+ years of experience in a QA, SDET, or software testing role, ideally on a production web application.

Strong, hands-on experience building and maintaining automated test suites integrated into a CI/CD pipeline (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar) — this is a key part of the role, not a secondary skill.

Experience testing both backend services (REST APIs) and browser-based front ends.

Comfort writing and validating SQL against relational databases (MySQL and/or PostgreSQL) to verify data-level correctness.

Experience with defect tracking and test-case management tools (e.g., Jira or similar).

Ability to read enough application code (Java, Scala, or similar JVM languages) to understand what a fix actually changed.

**Nice to Have**

Experience testing services deployed on Kubernetes, or working across containerized environments.

Familiarity with Spring Boot and Play Framework applications specifically.

Experience in a regulated or compliance-driven environment (SOC 2, life sciences, or similar).

Exposure to performance or load testing.

title: Mid-Senior AI Engineer - Generative AI & Agents
details:
**About Madar**

Madar is a leading Saudi digital logistics platform, owned by Elm, transforming transportation management

across industries.

Madar connects shippers, carriers, and logistics partners through a unified ecosystem that improves visibility,

efficiency, automation, and shipment execution.

The platform enables seamless shipment management, financial integration, real-time tracking, and

operational visibility, helping businesses move freight with greater speed, transparency, and confidence.

**About the Role**

Madar is looking for an experienced and hands-on Mid-Senior AI Engineer to design, build, and

productionize AI capabilities across our logistics platform.

The role combines Generative AI, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intelligent

automation, and applied machine learning to solve real logistics and operational problems.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, DevOps/Platform, Data, Security, and Operations teams to

take AI solutions from business requirements and prototypes into reliable production services.

The role will also help drive AI adoption across Madar's engineering organization by establishing reusable AI

development patterns, tools, standards, and engineering practices.

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building

production-grade AI and LLM applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

AI Product Development

* Design and build AI-powered logistics capabilities such as shipment assistants, customer-support assistants,

operational copilots, document intelligence, exception-handling workflows, and intelligent automation.

* Contribute to predictive AI use cases such as ETA prediction, anomaly detection, operational risk

identification, and shipment-related forecasting where appropriate.

* Translate product, business, and operational requirements into practical and reliable AI solutions.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to move AI capabilities from proof-of-concept to

production.

* Design reusable AI components and services that can be consumed across multiple Madar products and

engineering teams.

* Integrate AI services with Madar's existing Angular, Node.js, API, event-driven, and backend

platforms

**LLM & RAG Engineering**

* Design, build, and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines using embeddings, vector

databases, structured data, unstructured documents, and logistics-domain information.

* Implement effective document ingestion, chunking, indexing, retrieval, reranking, and

context-management strategies.

* Build AI applications using leading LLM platforms such as Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, or

equivalent enterprise AI platforms.

* Use AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, or equivalent

frameworks where appropriate.

* Design model-agnostic architectures that allow Madar to evaluate and adopt different models based on

capability, reliability, latency, security, and cost.

* Improve retrieval relevance, grounding, response accuracy, and overall application reliability.
* Design structured output and tool-calling patterns to reliably connect LLMs with business applications and

backend services.

AI Agents & Intelligent Automation

* Design and develop AI agents for logistics workflows such as dispatch assistance, customer support,

shipment exception handling, operations support, and internal productivity.

* Build reliable agentic workflows that combine LLM reasoning, deterministic business rules, APIs, enterprise

data, and external systems.

* Implement appropriate state management, memory, tool usage, workflow orchestration, and human

approval steps.

* Define boundaries between AI-driven decisions and deterministic application logic.
* Design human-in-the-loop workflows where AI-generated decisions or actions require review or approval.
* Ensure AI agents operate within clearly defined permissions and business boundaries.

**AI Evaluation & Quality Engineering**

* Design evaluation frameworks and test datasets for measuring AI system performance.
* Evaluate solutions across dimensions including retrieval quality, groundedness, hallucination rate, task

completion and success rate, response quality, accuracy, latency, reliability, token consumption, and cost.

* Establish regression testing for prompts, retrieval pipelines, models, tools, and agent workflows.
* Develop golden datasets and benchmark scenarios for critical Madar AI use cases.
* Apply human evaluation, automated evaluation, and LLM-as-a-judge approaches where appropriate.
* Continuously measure production AI performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

AI Security, Governance & Responsible AI

* Apply secure AI engineering practices to protect Madar's customers, systems, and business data.
* Implement controls against prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, sensitive information leakage,

unauthorized data access, excessive agent permissions, unsafe tool execution, and cross-user or

cross-tenant data exposure.

* Design secure authorization models for RAG applications and AI agents.
* Ensure AI applications respect existing application-level access controls and data boundaries.
* Apply secure secrets management and authentication when integrating AI services with internal and

external systems.

* Support auditability by implementing appropriate logging, tracing, and monitoring of AI interactions and

actions.

* Work with Security and Platform teams to establish practical AI governance and security standards

Engineering AI Adoption

* Drive practical adoption of Claude Code and other AI-assisted development tools across Madar

engineering teams.

* Develop reusable AI skills, subagents, prompt templates, engineering instructions, and development

workflows.

* Help engineers use AI effectively for coding, unit and integration testing, code reviews, debugging,

documentation, refactoring, application migrations, and infrastructure and automation tasks.

* Establish practical standards and engineering playbooks for AI-assisted software development.
* Identify engineering workflows where AI can improve development velocity, quality, or operational

efficiency.

* Support engineering teams in using AI responsibly without compromising software quality, security, or

maintainability.

**AI Platform, Production & MLOps**

* Design AI services for scalability, availability, maintainability, and production readiness.
* Build APIs and reusable services that allow AI functionality to be consumed by different Madar applications.
* Work with DevOps and Platform teams to establish CI/CD practices for AI applications.
* Implement observability for AI services, including application tracing, model and prompt performance,

request latency, token usage, model cost, error rates, and retrieval performance.

* Monitor production AI applications and continuously identify operational or quality issues.
* Optimize solutions based on quality, latency, throughput, infrastructure cost, and model/API cost.
* Support versioning and controlled rollout of models, prompts, embeddings, retrieval strategies, and agent

workflows.

Applied Machine Learning

Where business use cases require traditional machine learning rather than LLM-based approaches:

* Build or support predictive models for use cases such as ETA prediction, anomaly detection, classification,

forecasting, or operational intelligence.

* Perform feature engineering and model evaluation using historical operational data.
* Select appropriate statistical, machine-learning, or deep-learning techniques based on the problem rather

than defaulting to LLM-based solutions.

* Work with Data and Platform teams to operationalize ML models where required.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Node.js / TypeScript and integration with modern web application architectures.
* Experience with Angular or similar frontend frameworks is an advantage.
* Experience with logistics, transportation, supply chain, e-commerce, or B2B technology platforms.
* Experience implementing AI agents in production environments.
* Experience with Claude Code or similar AI-assisted software-development platforms.
* Experience with MLOps, AI observability, model lifecycle management, or AI production infrastructure.
* Experience with traditional machine-learning frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch,

or equivalent.

* Experience with OCR, document intelligence, document classification, or intelligent document processing.
* Experience with fine-tuning, model customization, or parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques.
* Experience working with Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, or other cloud-based AI platforms.
* Experience implementing enterprise AI security, AI governance, or responsible-AI practices.
* Experience designing AI solutions for multi-tenant, enterprise, or B2B SaaS platforms.

What Success Looks Like

**A successful AI Engineer in this role will:**

* Deliver AI capabilities that solve measurable logistics and operational problems.
* Move AI solutions beyond prototypes into reliable, secure, and observable production services.
* Build reusable AI patterns and services instead of isolated one-off implementations.
* Establish measurable standards for AI quality, reliability, latency, and cost.
* Enable engineering teams to use AI tools effectively and responsibly.
* Help Madar develop a scalable AI engineering capability that can support multiple products and business

use cases over time.

Mid-Senior AI Engineer - Generative AI & Agents

 **Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a

related technical field.

* 4+ years of software engineering experience, including approximately 1-2+ years of hands-on

experience building LLM or Generative AI applications.

* Strong programming skills in Python.
* Strong understanding of software engineering principles, APIs, distributed systems, and production

application development.

* Practical experience building RAG applications, including embeddings, vector databases, document

processing, and retrieval techniques.

* Experience designing and developing AI agents, tool-calling systems, and multi-step LLM workflows.
* Hands-on experience with AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, or

equivalent.

title: Maintenance Technician @Siemens Mobility Egypt
details:
Siemens Mobility (SMO) is the world’s leading provider of mobility solutions that enable the efficient, safe, and environmentally friendly transport of people and goods—helping to improve the quality of everyday life for millions worldwide.

Motivated by innovation, we develop intelligent solutions for the growing digitalization of the transport sector. Our offerings include rail vehicles, rail automation, road traffic management systems, rail electrification, and services.

In Egypt, Siemens Mobility is modernizing the mechanical signaling system on the **Benha-Port Said Railway** into a modern electronic signaling system according to the highest European safety standards (SIL-4). Spanning 219 km, this project is part of the broader Egypt National Railways Modernization Project (ENRMP) and aims to enhance the safety standards, increase the number of passenger trains, and boost freight capacity.

Today, we are recruiting for a **Maintenance Technician** to join our team in Egypt. This is an excellent career opportunity for professionals looking to join a truly international team in one of the biggest projects of Siemens Mobility.

* Perform preventive, corrective, and routine maintenance on signaling (Interlocking, Point Machines, Track circuits, signals and Level Crossing), Telecom, Power Supply, and MEP equipment according to approved maintenance plans and OEM manuals.
* Carry out inspections to identify faults and abnormal conditions.
* Respond to system faults and alarms as directed by supervisors or engineers.
* Support fault finding, troubleshooting, and replacement of faulty or worn components.
* Use maintenance tools, test equipment, and spare parts correctly and responsibly.
* Maintain good housekeeping in buildings, workshops, and field locations.

* Good English communication skills, ability to read technical manuals, and a good understanding of electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, cooling, and other related systems.
* Minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in the railway sector, preferably in Signaling or Telecom.
* Must have a valid driving license
* Maintenance activities in one or more of the following fields: Signaling, Power, Telecom, or MEP.
* Attention to detail, professional manners, communication, teamwork, and the ability to work efficiently and under pressure.

title: Network Technician Supervisor
details:
**Job Purpose**

Supervise technicians and provide hands-on support for network cabling, CCTV systems, UPS maintenance, and

equipment installation across HQ and remote sites. Ensure reliable operation and completion of work according

to approved standards and schedules.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Team Supervision & Work Planning**

* Assign installation and maintenance tasks, organize site visits, and follow up on completion.
* Guide technicians and review workmanship, testing, and labeling.
* Coordinate priorities with IT Operations and the Network & Cybersecurity team.

**2. Network Cabling & Equipment Installation**

* Supervise copper and fiber-optic cabling, termination, patching, testing, and rack organization.
* Oversee installation and replacement of switches, wireless access points, and related equipment under the

Network team’s guidance.

* Verify cable routes, outlet locations, rack layouts, and material requirements.

**3. CCTV Installation & Maintenance**

* Supervise installation, cabling, positioning, and replacement of CCTV cameras, NVRs/DVRs, and related

equipment.

* Troubleshoot camera connectivity, recording, storage, and image issues.
* Conduct preventive checks and coordinate access, retention, and configuration requirements with

authorized owners and technical teams.

**4. UPS Inspection & Maintenance**

* Schedule UPS preventive maintenance and inspect alarms, battery status, load levels, and operating

conditions.

* Maintain maintenance logs, battery replacement schedules, and warranty records.
* Coordinate fault repairs, battery replacements, and electrical work with qualified vendors and Facilities.
* Follow up on UPS monitoring connectivity and escalate power or capacity issues.

**5. Troubleshooting & Site Coordination**

* Lead troubleshooting of physical network faults and plan preventive inspections of cabling, racks, CCTV, and

UPS equipment.

* Coordinate site access, installations, relocations, and maintenance with Facilities, contractors, and vendors.
* Inspect contractor work, follow up on defects, and ensure safe working practices.

**6. Documentation & Material Control**

* Maintain cable schedules, port mappings, rack layouts, CCTV layouts, equipment records, and test results.
* Track tools, spare parts, maintenance materials, and replenishment requirements.
* Report work progress, outstanding faults, and maintenance status to the IT Operations Manager.

 **Requirements**

* Technical diploma or equivalent qualification in Electronics, Telecommunications, Networking, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in network installation, CCTV support, and UPS maintenance coordination.
* Strong hands-on installation and troubleshooting experience across multiple sites.
* Ability to organize field activities, guide technicians, and inspect contractor work.
* Willingness to travel between HQ and remote sites.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Practical knowledge of Cat6/Cat6A cabling, RJ45 termination, patch panels, and fiber-optic handling and testing.
* Familiarity with switches, wireless access points, PoE, IP addressing, and network troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of IP cameras, NVRs/DVRs, recording storage, and CCTV maintenance.
* Understanding of UPS operation, battery health, load capacity, alarms, and preventive maintenance procedures.
* Experience using cable testers and installation tools and reading technical layouts.
* Relevant networking, CCTV, or UPS training is an advantage.

title: Communications/AFC Maintenance Section Manager @Siemens Mobility Egypt
details:
Siemens Mobility (SMO) is the world's leading provider of mobility solutions that enable the efficient, safe, and environmentally friendly transport of people and goods, helping to improve the quality of everyday life for millions worldwide.

Motivated by innovation, we develop intelligent solutions for the growing digitalization of the transport sector. Our offerings include rail vehicles, rail automation, road traffic management systems, rail electrification, and services.

In Egypt, Siemens Mobility is delivering one of the country's first high-speed rail systems. This landmark project, spanning approximately 2,000 kilometers, will connect 60 cities across Egypt, transforming transportation for both passengers and goods. Joining this project could be a pivotal milestone in your career and a significant achievement for the region.

Today, we are recruiting for a **COMMS/AFC Maintenance Section Manager** to join our team in Egypt. This is an excellent career opportunity for professionals who want to join a truly international team on one of the biggest projects of Siemens Mobility.

### **What are my responsibilities?**

* Manage COM and AFC maintenance activities, workforce, resources, and performance against operational and contractual requirements.
* Implement approved preventive, corrective, and condition-based maintenance plans, procedures, and technical standards for both disciplines.
* Perform task-based risk assessments (HIRA) for every work scope in your section.
* Oversee maintenance execution, work order progress, defects, and resource allocation with MCC and Scheduling.
* Ensure qualified personnel, spares, tools, equipment, and technical documentation are available and used effectively.
* Coordinate responses to major faults and service disruptions, including troubleshooting, recovery, and corrective actions.
* Monitor system reliability, availability, maintenance KPIs, and recurring failures, and drive improvement initiatives.
* Lead, develop, and evaluate section personnel, coordinating competence, training, and authorization needs with Training & Competence.
* Manage technical and operational interfaces with Operations, Engineering, Asset Management, IT, Materials & Logistics, EHS, Quality, and suppliers.
* Ensure safe, compliant maintenance, accurate CMMS records, reporting, audits, and operational readiness.
* Plan and control section expenditure within delegated authority, and identify cost-efficiency opportunities.
* Direct COM and AFC engineers, shift supervisors, and technicians, and coordinate external service providers.

### **What do I need to qualify for this job?**

* A bachelor's degree in telecommunications, electronics, electrical, computer, railway engineering, or a comparable discipline.
* 10 to 12 years of relevant experience in communications, fare collection, railway systems, or comparable infrastructure maintenance.
* At least 3 years in technical supervision, team leadership, or maintenance management.
* Experience managing maintenance execution, service performance, contractors, and multidisciplinary technical interfaces.
* A good understanding of communications networks, AFC equipment, and their operational interfaces.
* Strong planning, personnel management, problem-solving, and incident coordination skills.
* Ability to manage KPIs, maintenance priorities, budgets, and cross-functional interfaces.
* Strong spoken and written English, with effective leadership and stakeholder communication.
* Proficiency with CMMS, reporting tools, and standard office applications.

* Access offices, depots, stations, equipment rooms, and other operational areas, and meet Fitness Class 2 and role-specific medical requirements.

### **What else do I need to know?**

You will report to General Maintenance Management or your designated line manager. Your working hours follow regular office hours, with additional or on-call support during incidents and operational needs. You will work from offices, depots, stations, and project locations across the railway network. You will wear the required PPE, follow station, depot, equipment-room, and track access rules, travel between project locations, and support major incidents when required.

As a world leader in developing and producing the most advanced technologies, we improve lives and further human achievements worldwide, while also protecting the climate. We give you the chance to do something significant that benefits society and human progress, and to make a real difference.

At Siemens, we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse Digital Minds to develop tomorrow's reality. Find out more about the Digital World of Siemens here: www.siemens.com/careers/digitalminds

Diversity at Siemens is our source of creativity and innovation. Different types of talent and experience make us more ambitious and better prepared to meet the demands of society. We value candidates who reflect that diversity. Find out more at www.siemens.com.

title: Head of Operations
details:
**About The Role**
==================

Thndr is building the primary investment account in Egypt and aims to redefine active trading across the MENA region into one platform. We believe stock markets are the flywheel of the economy. Deep, liquid, and accessible capital markets drive capital formation, encourage entrepreneurship, and create a virtuous cycle of wealth creation.

The Operations function sits in the core of the engine. As Head of Operations, you'll own that engine. The mandate is operational excellence at scale: build operations across systems that run reliably, raise the standard of execution, and shape how the function performs as Thndr expands across markets, asset classes, and millions of customers.

**What You'll Do**
==================

You'll define the operating model across Trading Ops, Financial Ops, and Account Opening: how the team is organised and what success looks like at every level

You'll own the daily and ad-hoc cycles that keep the platform running end-to-end across every market we operate in.

* Daily settlement, end of day processes, and reconciliation cycles across the different markets
* Corporate actions: dividends, splits, capital increases, IPOs, tender offers, and the rest of the lifecycle
* Mutual fund operations: order processing, payments, reconciliation with asset managers, onboarding new funds
* Funding operations across all channels, with same-day exception handling
* Build and grow the team that delivers all of this — operations managers and specialists across trading, money movement, and account opening
* You'll own incident management as a core operational discipline

**What You'll Need**
====================

We're looking for someone with sharp analytical instincts, a builder's orientation, and the operational discipline to execute at pace in a complex environment.

The background that sets you up well: strategy consulting, investment banking, business operations, or a high-ownership generalist role at a fast-growing company.

Specifically:

* Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems and build operating systems that scale
* Strong analytical skills; comfortable with data and able to turn findings into a clear narrative. Ability to learn and rely heavily on SQL
* Experience managing and developing people, with high standards for performance and culture
* A strong cross-functional partner — able to work closely with Product, Tech, and Compliance, and to manage external partners (exchanges, clearing houses, asset managers, banks)
* Conviction that automation and AI are core to how the function scales
* Ability to learn and apply new regulatory and operational frameworks quickly
* Fluency in Arabic and English
* Prior operations experience in financial services is a plus

**Who Are We?**
===============

**Thndr** was founded on a **bold dream** to democratize access to investing through smart tech and human-centric design. This is simply our way of saying we give anyone with a smartphone the simple and easy access they need to preserve and grow their wealth. At the same time, we’re shaping the future of investing while actively driving the economies we serve by promoting local investment products.

History has shown that investing is the single greatest way to build long-term wealth, but before **Thndr**, only a very small percentage of people had access to it due to:

* High barriers to entry — In the form of excessive minimum account balances, complex, outdated onboarding, and low financial literacy.
* Irrelevant experience — Catered toward expert traders and financial specialists, therefore alienating the majority of the population.
* Fragmented offering — Investment products were not gathered in a single, intuitive outlet.

We don't just talk about change, we deliver it. Here's a glimpse into our impact so far:

* **5.5 million** app downloads
* **EGP 1B+ average daily traded value** across 2025
* **#1 digital investing platform** in Egypt for the **third consecutive year**
* **76% of users are first-time investors**
* **40%** of our users come from outside of capital cities and have previously had limited access to financial institutions

Building on the success of our core platform, we are continuing to change culture and break down barriers by launching **Rumble**, the subscription-based investment recommendations platform.

**Rumble** was born with the vision to empower everyday individuals to build wealth confidently and intelligently through access to timely and in-depth advice from the industry’s top experts.

Going beyond traditional investment advice, it offers long and short-term investment recommendations and financial content through engaging articles and videos that guide users on their financial journey and maximize their returns.

At **Thndr**, we're looking for people driven by our mission to help us democratize investing across the MENA region.

title: Senior Project Manager II
details:
**Date de publication :** Oct 09, 2026, 12:00AM
  
Join us at Orange Business!
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
We are seeking a Senior Project Manager to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from concept through delivery and operational handover. The successful candidate will apply project management practices across the full project life cycle, adapt delivery approaches to suit the work, and coordinate teams, stakeholders, suppliers, and technology partners.
  
The role requires practical knowledge of PMI/PMP project management principles, Agile and Scrum, Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and GenAI LLM . It also calls for familiarity with cloud platforms and certifications, AI literacy—including agentic AI—and workflow orchestration .
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Project life-cycle leadership
  
  

* Lead work across the full project life cycle:
* Initiation: clarify the business need, objectives, expected benefits, stakeholders, assumptions, constraints, and high-level scope.
* Planning: develop and maintain the integrated project management plan, scope, schedule, budget, resourcing, quality, communications, procurement, risk, and stakeholder engagement plans.
* Execution: coordinate delivery teams, manage dependencies and suppliers, facilitate decisions, and support effective communication and collaboration.
* Monitoring and controlling: track progress against baselines, manage forecasts and performance measures, assess risks and issues, control changes, and report status transparently.
* Closing and transition: confirm acceptance, complete handover to operations, close contracts and documentation, capture lessons learned, and support benefits tracking.
* Define project governance, decision rights, escalation paths, tolerances, and reporting cadence.
* Establish and maintain scope, schedule, cost, resource, risk, issue, dependency, assumption, and change controls.
* Manage integrated plans and dependencies across business, product, technology, data, security, and operations teams.
* Use appropriate project controls and reporting methods, including milestone tracking, forecasts, dashboards, and earned-value concepts where relevant.
* Identify delivery risks early; develop mitigation, contingency, and recovery plans.
* Manage changes through impact assessment, approval, communication, and baseline updates.
* Ensure quality planning, assurance, acceptance criteria, testing coordination, and readiness for release.
* Coordinate procurement, vendors, contracts, and third-party delivery commitments as required.
* Lead project reviews, steering committee meetings, decision forums, and executive updates.
* Support benefits realization by aligning delivery outcomes with business objectives and tracking agreed measures after implementation.

Agile, Scrum, and SAFe delivery
  
  

* Select and tailor predictive, iterative, Agile, or hybrid approaches to fit project context, uncertainty, governance, and organizational needs.
* Apply Scrum practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily coordination, reviews, retrospectives, and increment delivery.
* Work effectively with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, engineering teams, and business stakeholders while respecting their accountabilities.
* Support backlog visibility, prioritization, acceptance criteria, release planning, and delivery forecasting.
* Demonstrate working knowledge of SAFe concepts and terminology, including Agile Release Trains, PI Planning, team and program backlogs, dependencies, and Inspect and Adapt events.
* Coordinate across teams and delivery trains, escalating impediments and managing cross-team risks and dependencies.
* Help teams improve delivery flow, transparency, predictability, and continuous learning.

Cloud, AI, and automation
  
  

* Demonstrate an understanding of cloud delivery considerations, such as shared-responsibility models, security, privacy, resilience, cost management, and migration or modernization dependencies.
* Coordinate cloud-related initiatives with architecture, engineering, security, data, and operations teams.
* Maintain relevant cloud knowledge or certifications, such as:
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or an equivalent AWS certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) or an equivalent Azure certification.
* Google Cloud Digital Leader or an equivalent Google Cloud certification.
* Apply sound AI literacy to project planning and delivery, including awareness of generative AI, data quality, model limitations, evaluation, human oversight, privacy, security, and responsible-use considerations.
* Understand agentic AI at a practical level, including AI agents’ goals, tools, permissions, context, monitoring, escalation, and human approval points.
* Assess AI use cases for suitability, risks, governance requirements, value, and operational readiness; do not treat autonomous outputs as inherently reliable.
* Identify opportunities to automate repeatable workflows and coordinate automation initiatives with relevant technical and business owners.
* Demonstrate familiarity with workflow orchestration platforms such as n8n, including triggers, workflows, integrations, error handling, access controls, and monitoring.
* Coordinate safe integration of AI agents and automations with enterprise systems, including testing, auditability, fallback procedures, and appropriate human-in-the-loop controls.

Required Qualifications and Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in project management, business, technology, or a related field.
* Significant experience managing complex, cross-functional projects or programs, including ownership of plans, governance, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communications.
* PMP certification or equivalent demonstrable knowledge of PMI project management practices.
* Practical experience with Agile and Scrum delivery; knowledge of SAFe in a scaled environment.
* Experience working with cloud-based products, platforms, migrations, or infrastructure initiatives.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled solutions, automation, or workflow orchestration tools such as n8n
* Strong written and verbal communication, facilitation, negotiation, prioritization, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate business objectives into delivery plans and communicate complex information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Skills & Qualifications
  
  

* SAFe certification, such as SAFe Agilist (SA), SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), or another role-appropriate credential.
* Scrum certification, such as Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent experience.
* One or more current cloud certifications from AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Training or practical experience in AI governance, responsible AI, agentic systems, or workflow automation.
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, MS Project, Confluence, or n8n.
* Experience delivering in regulated, security-sensitive, or highly integrated environments.
* Good interpersonal skills, a sense of communication and animation
* Fluent in French / English
* A good knowledge of ITIL processes
* Certifications: ITILv4, SYNERGY, PMP/Prince 2 or equivalent

You bring open mindedness, ability to handle pressure, leading with courage and empathy, assertiveness and communicate effectively.
  
  

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: Training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

Chez Orange, seules vos compétences comptent.
  
  
Quel que soit votre âge, genre, origine, parcours, religion, orientation sexuelle, handicap, neuroatypie, ou apparence, nous encourageons activement la diversité au sein de nos équipes, car elle constitue une force pour le collectif et un vecteur d’innovation.
  
  
**Orange est une entreprise handi-accueillante :** n’hésitez pas à nous faire part de vos besoins spécifiques.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* 7 to 12 years in technology governance, or vendor/sourcing management, including at least 3 to 4 years inside a regulated institution
* Direct experience managing technology vendor relationships at scale
* Financial modeling literacy, comfortable building and defending a multi-year cost comparison without needing to be a Finance-grade modeler
* Precision in written and verbal reporting
* Some exposure to a build or launch phase specifically, not just steady-state setups, is desirable

**YOU’LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU**

* You'd rather build the governance layer than inherit a spreadsheet nobody trusts
* You treat a vendor scorecard as a tool for accountability, not a formality to file away
* You can defend a number in front of a CTO or board, not just produce it
* You see cost optimization as a discipline, not a one-time exercise

**OBJECTIVES OF THE PROGRAMME**
-------------------------------

In the dynamic heart of EMRO, the Human Resources and Talent Unit propels the WHO mission forward by championing a culture of empowerment and innovation. HRT envisions an environment where each individual's unique talents are celebrated, collaboration sparks creativity, and bold ideas drive transformative change. HRT cultivates a space that thrives on diversity, nurtures leadership at every level, and harnesses cutting-edge technology to shape the future of global health to lead, to grow, and to make an extraordinary impact.

The incumbent serves as the WHO EMR Staff Counsellor and is responsible for providing a full range of counselling services to the organization and its workforce, assisting in addressing psychosocial hazards and psychosocial needs.

EMR Staff Counsellor works at the three strategic levels (organizational, team/managerial and individual) of intervention in areas of prevention, promotion and support of workplace mental health and wellbeing.

**DESCRIPTION OF DUTIES**
-------------------------

The incumbent will perform the following duties:

* Provide effective and evidence-based psychosocial support and counselling to the WHO workforce and their families with the objective of mitigating stress and psychosocial risk factors and promoting protective factors.
* Facilitate referrals to external mental health providers and internal support services.
* Provide timely critical incident stress management to groups and/or individual staff following critical incidents and ensure the appropriate follow-up of staff and dependents.
* In line with the UN mental health strategy, and under the supervision of the RHRM and the staff counsellor network, adapt and implement a comprehensive mental health programme in collaboration with relevant counterparts.
* Participate in implementation of WHO Mental health and Wellbeing Strategy and related programmes and activities.
* Contribute to the development of a regional Action Plan and guide its implementation for mental health and staff well-being.
* Assist in assessing and addressing psychological risk factors at the individual, unit and organizational levels. Provide advice and guidance to the Leadership and Management of the region/Country Office on occupational health and wellbeing action plans.
* Provide support to managers on matters related to workplace mental health and wellbeing, including team and performance management aspects.
* Provide pre- and post - deployment assignment briefings to staff being deployed to/returning from emergency or hardship duty stations.
* Participate in case management with internal services. Support continuity of support and follow up, including high risk cases and death in service.
* Design and deliver training and awareness raising materials and activities for staff and managers on themes related to mental health andwell-being in the workplace Participate in newcomer's induction trainings.
* Strengthen the network of Peer Support Volunteers (PSV), including the training and technical supervision of the Peer Support Volunteers.
* Coordinate with UNDSS, HQ Staff Counsellor and other Regional Staff Counsellors, UN staff/stress counsellors, Peer Support Volunteers and other relevant stakeholders to ensure adequate psycho-social support during emergencies.
* Contribute to development and review of policies on occupational mental health and wellbeing and perform administrative duties, including participating in regional meetings and other activities.
* Maintain records of activities, in line with WHO and UNSSCG best practices, and provide relevant reports to the Regional HR Manager.
* Take part in the relevant interagency working groups, particularly those within the UNSSCG aimed at advancement of psychosocial support to staff in the UN.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
---------------------------

### **Education**

**Essential**: First university degree in psychology, social work, clinical psychology, psychiatry, mental health nursing, marriage and family therapy, psychotherapy, psychological counselling, or a related field from an accredited/recognized institution.

Registration, certification, or a valid license to practice as a mental health professional in the relevant jurisdiction is required.

**Desirable**: Master's degree in clinical psychology, counselling psychology, psychiatry, social work, occupational health, or a related discipline from an accredited/recognized institution.

Additional relevant training or certification in stress management, conflict resolution, cross-cultural communication, alcohol or substance abuse, resilience, mediation, trauma, sleep, or a related area, and membership in a recognized professional organization.

### **Experience**

**Essential**: At least five (5) years of progressively responsible professional experience in counselling, workplace mental health, or psychosocial support relevant to the duties, including international exposure. Demonstrated experience in data management and analysis and in supporting emergency or critical-incident responses is required.

**Desirable**: Working experience with UN Common System Organizations, international NGOs.

Experience either working in a hardship location or providing counselling services to staff working under very difficult and security compromised environments is an asset.

Experience of working in occupational health setting is an asset.

### **Skills**

* Proven ability to accurately assess psychosocial hazards and risks in occupational setting.
* Advance knowledge in provision of psychosocial support and counselling services in a professional and confidential manner.
* Ability to fulfill professional duties in a multicultural environment while displaying sensitivity and respect for diversity.
* Ability to contribute to managing crisis situations exerting professionalism and strict confidentiality, in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
* Ability to identify clients' needs and suggest appropriate solutions.
* Excellent communications kills (oral, written and presentation).
* Skills in designing and delivering trainings/information sessions on a number of subjects and ability to adapt those to different audiences.
* Professionalism, integrity and respect for diversity professionally and personally.
* Establish and maintain effective working relations in a multi-cultural, multi-ethnic environment with sensitivity and respect for diversity.
* Ability to coordinate with other relevant specialist service in the Organization.
* Excellent interpersonal and respectful communication skills when interacting with clients and with internal and external counterparts.
* Capacity to work with shifting priorities and flexibility to adapt the plans to new realities.
* Being ready to respond to emergency situations that may be out of working hours.
* Capacity of working in multidisciplinary teams and being confident to share their views and advice as needed.
* Being able and ready to work under pressure but also knowing their boundaries and integrating them into the way of working.
* Being self-driven and organized, respectful of deadlines.
* Commitment to on-going professional development and clinical supervision, personal growth.
* The Staff Counsellor is a member of the UN Staff/Stress Counsellor Group, and the incumbent must adhere to its professional and ethical standards, keeping updated of the best practices and guidance through their professional networks, including within WHO and the UN system.

### **WHO Competencies**

Teamwork  
Respecting and promoting individual and cultural differences  
Communication  
Moving forward in a changing environment  
Producing results

### **Use of Language Skills**

**Essential**: Expert knowledge of English.  
**Desirable**: Intermediate knowledge of Arabic.

----------------

The remuneration for the above position comprises an annual base salary starting at USD 71,335 (subject to mandatory deductions for pension contributions and health insurance, as applicable), a variable post adjustment, which reflects the cost of living in a particular duty station, and currently amounts to USD 1718 per month for the duty station indicated above.
